A soft-focus, dreamy background with a deep indigo sky and a giant, silver full moon.

backgrounds.title: The Obsidian Champagne Ballroom
backgrounds.description: Prestigious ballroom with gold bokeh and cinematic depth
backgrounds.prompt: A deep obsidian ballroom featuring vertical light pillars and suspended gold bokeh. Soft-focus particles of champagne-gold dust drift through the air, creating a prestigious, high-contrast atmosphere with cinematic depth

backgrounds.title: The Grand Emerald Ballroom
backgrounds.description: A grand ballroom with rich emerald green velvet-textured walls
backgrounds.prompt: A grand ballroom featuring rich emerald green velvet-textured walls and dark mahogany flooring. Subtle, dim lighting from wall sconces creates deep shadows, while the ceiling molding is a matte charcoal gray.

backgrounds.title: The Stonewall Dungeon
backgrounds.description: Mysterious dungeon with aged stone walls and flickering torchlight
backgrounds.prompt: A dungeon-themed background with aged stone walls covered in flickering, warm-toned torchlight. Faded, hand-drawn maps and ancient-looking scrolls are pinned to the walls. Cobwebs and antique, rusty props like keys and tattered cloaks are artfully placed, creating a mysterious and playful atmosphere.

backgrounds.title: The Electric Pulse Dance Floor
backgrounds.description: High-energy dance floor with pulsing LED patterns and laser beams
backgrounds.prompt: A dynamic, multi-colored LED dance floor that pulses in a pattern of magenta, electric blue, and gold. The scene is a blur of swirling lights and laser beams that cut through the darkness, creating a high-energy, party atmosphere. Abstract, futuristic geometric shapes reflect the lights, adding depth and a modern touch.

backgrounds.title: The Twilight Gothic Fortress
backgrounds.description: Epic cinematic view from the battlements of a gothic castle at twilight
backgrounds.prompt: A wide-angle cinematic shot from the stone battlements of a massive gothic fortress at twilight. The background reveals the entire castle complex with towering keeps and bridges under a moody charcoal and amethyst sky pierced by blood-orange sunlight. The foreground features a spacious, well-lit weathered stone platform framed by ancient ramparts, providing a clear stage for a portrait while capturing the castle's epic scale.

backgrounds.title: Jewel HSBC Rain Vortex
backgrounds.name: Jewel HSBC Rain Vortex
backgrounds.description: Dramatic indoor waterfall and lush tropical forest at Jewel Changi
backgrounds.prompt: A cinematic, low-angle view looking up at the HSBC Rain Vortex, the world’s tallest indoor waterfall, cascades dramatically from a vaulted glass-and-steel ceiling. Surrounding the waterfall, the lush, multi-tiered indoor forest of the Shiseido Forest Valley creates a grand, tropical backdrop, with soft mist and hidden accent lights reflecting shimmering colors across the dense canopy.
